restartNote: HA means a restart with a short outage, not zero downtime. Only vMotion moves running servers without interruption.

infra.title: Network, storage and power
infra.storageNote: Shared array with two controllers, reached by every host over two paths. Alternative: vSAN on the three hosts (FTT=1). It survives one host failure but cannot rebuild its copies until the host is back.

load.title: Cluster load and admission control
load.label: Memory used by the VMs
load.ok: N+1 is kept: any one host may fail.
load.over: Above the N+1 limit: after a host failure not every VM can restart.
load.ac: In production, admission control would refuse to start more VMs above {pct} %. It is off here so you can see the effect.

drs.title: DRS (load balancing)
drs.balanced: The hosts are balanced. No recommendation.
drs.recommend: Memory use differs by {pct} points. DRS recommends:
drs.noVcenter: vCenter is not running: DRS and vMotion pause. HA restarts still work without it.

rule.title: Anti-affinity
rule.violated: {a} and {b} share a host. Only one host was left, and HA prefers running over separating.

isolation.title: Host isolation
isolation.text: A host loses its management network but keeps running. Through the shared storage (datastore heartbeat) the others see that it is alive.

log.title: What happens
log.empty: Nothing has happened yet. Fail a host or a component.
log.hostNoNetwork: {host} loses both uplinks. Its VMs stop.
log.hostNoStorage: {host} loses every storage path. Its VMs stop.
log.noCapacity: {vm} cannot restart: no host has {gb} GB free.
log.maintenanceDone: {host} is empty and can be serviced.
log.migrated: {vm} moved to {host} with vMotion, without interruption.
log.stuck: {vm} stays on {host}: vMotion needs vCenter and free memory elsewhere.
log.exitMaintenance: {host} leaves maintenance mode. It stays empty until DRS moves VMs to it.
log.restored: {host} is back. It stays empty until DRS moves VMs to it.
log.isolatedKeep: Its VMs keep running: the storage heartbeat shows the host is alive.

tunnel.backup: {site}: tunnel re-established over the failover path

warn.maintenance: {host} is in maintenance: the N+1 reserve is in use while it lasts.
warn.antiAffinity: Anti-affinity broken until a second host is back.

internet.how: Two providers on different media; the firewall switches over by itself.
internet.fails: Short interruption, then the second line carries everything; clinic tunnels re-establish.

firewall.how: Active/passive pair with a shared address.
firewall.fails: The second node takes over within seconds; tunnels re-establish.

core.how: Two switches (MLAG); every host and firewall is connected to both.
core.fails: No outage; half the bandwidth until it is replaced.

uplinks.how: Two uplinks per host, one to each core switch.
uplinks.fails: No outage; traffic moves to the remaining uplink.

hosts.how: Three hosts, one host of capacity in reserve (N+1), HA enabled.
hosts.fails: VMs restart on the other hosts: a few minutes of outage.

storage-ctl.how: Two controllers, every host with paths to both.
storage-ctl.fails: No outage; the other controller takes over the paths.

power.how: Two UPS; servers have two power supplies, one on each.
power.fails: Servers keep running; single-feed devices hand over to their partner.

identity.how: Two servers, never on the same host (anti-affinity).
identity.fails: No outage; one server answers alone.

vcenter.how: A single VM, restarted by HA like any other.
vcenter.fails: Running VMs and HA keep working; DRS, vMotion and changes pause.

array.how: One chassis, redundant inside; nightly backup and an offsite copy.
array.fails: Remaining single point: restore from backup. Accepted at this size.

room.how: One location; an immutable offsite backup copy.
room.fails: Disaster case: rebuild from the offsite copy. A second site would remove this risk.

before.title: Before: one server per service
before.text: Each service on its own physical box. If a box fails, its service is gone until the hardware is repaired.
before.now: In the cluster, the same failure is a restart of a few minutes.
